text:
maria (Marketing): Hey team — need a compact benchmark one-pager for inbound + webinar hero. Goal: a quick visual we can use in ads, email headers, and the webinar landing hero. Low wordcount, 2 messaging variants (cost-first vs latency-first), and a small sparkline showing tokens-per-second vs $/k tokens. Due EOD Wed.

jasper (Design): can you confirm final dimensions and format? svg + png exports? also do we need desktop and mobile crops?

maria (Marketing): desktop hero 1200x600, mobile crop 640x360, plus a square 800x800 for socials. export: svg for brand, 2 png sizes for each crop. single artboard with responsive crop guides.

liam (Growth): audience split: 1) PLG devs (care about latency & SDK), CTA = "Try the benchmark"; 2) Platform buyers (care about cost & SLAs), CTA = "See pricing + commits". suggest we test both CTAs.

jasper (Design): ok. will do 2 layout variants: "metric-forward" and "narrative-forward". Quick ask: do we have a short 1-line stat for each variant (eg: "20–40ms median latency" / "40% lower per-token cost") or should I pull from the benchmark sheet?

maria (Marketing): pull from the most recent bench sheet (sheet name: "November-inbound-bench v3"). prioritize stable metrics not peak numbers. for copy keep it ~6–10 words for headline, 12–18 for subhead.

olivia (Legal): quick flag — avoid absolute claims like "cheapest" or "always". use qualifying language: "up to" or "on typical workloads". also add small footnote for methodology link.

jasper (Design): noted. will add footnote area and small "methodology" link. rough timeline: mockups by tomorrow noon, review pass midday, final assets by EOD Wed. ok to iterate after handoff? :thumbsup:

maria (Marketing): yes. schedule review at 12:30pm tomorrow. pls include Figma link in thread.

jasper (Design): Figma draft uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/bench-hero-quickdraft — permissions open to org. export settings I'm planning: ```export: png 2x, svg, pdf; slices: hero-desktop_1200x600, hero-mobile_640x360, social_800x800```

liam (Growth): heads up — for ads we need a variant with no CTAs (for brand lift test). also request a tiny animated GIF of the sparkline (3 frames) if feasible.

jasper (Design): GIF is doable — will make a 3-frame micro-animation. will push GIF + static PNGs.

assets-bot: uploaded mock_v1.zip to /Shared/marketing/bench-hero/mock_v1.zip (contains fig, exports, README).

maria (Marketing): thanks. one more ask — can we get two headline copy options per layout and two colors (brand blue and inverted dark) so growth can run creative A/Bs?

jasper (Design): yep. deliverables list I'll hand off: 2 layouts x 2 headlines x 2 colorways x 3 crops + GIF + export package + fig link + README. estimate: final package ~8 files + GIF.

olivia (Legal): once final, please ping legal for sign-off on messaging language. I can do a 1-hour turnaround if copy is short.

maria (Marketing): perfect. thanks everyone — I'll post the review sheet after first pass. tagging @jasper for lunchtime check-in.

jasper (Design): will update thread when mock v2 is ready. :sparkles:
